jessica_pm: Quick flag from partner call with AstraCore + BlueBison (SI). Their security team will only allow outbound connections via an approved egress proxy and refuses creating any public load balancer during the private deploy. BlueBison's chart currently spins up a LB for the runtime-callback service.

omar_si: They hit pod readiness flaps. Kube events: failed to POST to webhook onboarding endpoint (connection timed out). They can only reach the internet via `egress-proxy.astra.svc.cluster.local:3128`.

liam_ops: This is a common pattern. We support an "egress-only" mode by configuring the callback to talk to the control-plane proxy or an internal egress proxy; the helm values are `callback.service.type=ClusterIP` and `callback.env.CALLBACK_TARGET` set to the proxy FQDN.

jessica_pm: Can we give BlueBison a copy-paste overlay and a short checklist? They want to proceed tonight.

tara_sre: Yup. Minimal values.yaml overlay: 

```yaml
# avoid external LB for callback
callback:
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
env:
  CALLBACK_MODE: "egress-proxy"
  CALLBACK_TARGET: "egress-proxy.astra.svc.cluster.local:3128"
```

tara_sre: Also add this k8s NetworkPolicy snippet so runtime pods can egress to the proxy namespace, and ensure the proxy service has a headless or ClusterIP entry so DNS resolves inside the cluster.

omar_si: What about TLS? Customer wants end-to-end encrypted traffic and audit of certs.

tara_sre: Two options: 1) proxy performs TLS passthrough and we use our client cert sidecar (`redwood-cert-bootstrap`) to present mTLS to the upstream; or 2) proxy terminates TLS and re-encrypts upstream to control plane. For option 1 set `CALLBACK_TLS_MODE=passthrough`. If they need cert rotation, annotate pods with `redwood.com/cert-rotate: "true"`.

jessica_pm: BlueBison is nervous about cert rotation windows and KMS access. Any documented flow?

liam_ops: Yes — private-control-plane supports a key-provisioning flow. We have a short runbook: exchange service account, add `redwood-kms-role` to their infra IAM, then sidecar fetches certs on pod start and refreshes via cron. I'll paste the runbook link.

si_onboard_bot: Note: private-deploy-quickrunbook.md updated 2026-03-02 by eng-infra. Link: https://internal.redwood/private-deploy-quickrunbook.md

omaar_si: Small ask from their change approvers: can we provide a simple ASCII traffic flow they can paste into the CAB packet?

liam_ops: Sure. Example: 

Runtime Pod -> (ClusterIP) -> Egress Proxy (egress-proxy.astra.svc) -> Control Plane Proxy -> Redwood Private Control Plane -> Redwood hosted endpoints

liam_ops: Also checklist for BlueBison before they try again: 1) apply overlay values.yaml, 2) ensure NetworkPolicy allows egress to proxy namespace, 3) enable cert-bootstrap annotation if using mTLS, 4) run `curl` from a test pod to the proxy FQDN to validate DNS/egress.

jessica_pm: They asked if eng-oncall should be on standby in case of driver/kernel issues during their window. The window is 01:00-03:00 UTC.

tara_sre: I'll be oncall 01:00-02:00 UTC. If they hit GPU driver OOMs or node-level crashes collect: `kubectl logs --previous`, `dmesg`, and `kubectl get events --all-namespaces`. Escalate to eng-runtime with those logs.

omar_si: Thanks. I'll send over the overlay, runbook link, and the ASCII flow. We'll proceed with the CAB approval request.

jessica_pm: Please cc me on the ticket. BlueBison wants an explicit sign-off once the overlay is applied and callbacks are validated.

si_onboard_bot: Ticket #SI-5072 created: "AstraCore egress-only deploy support" assignees: omar_si, liam_ops. Status: triaged.
